q: Billy Graham yakulira wa, era yafuuka atya Omukristaayo?
a: Yazaalibwa nga 7 Novemba 1918 ku faamu y’ente ez’amata ey’amaka ge okumpi ne Charlotte, North Carolina, mu maka ag’ekkanisa ya Reformed Presbyterian agaagendanga mu kkanisa obutayosa, era nga emirimu gy’awaka gitandika obudde nga tebunnakya. Tewaaliwo kintu na kimu mu bulamu obwo obwa bulijjo obw’omu byalo ekyamwawula ku balala okutuusa lwe yaweza emyaka kkumi na mukaaga, mu 1934, omubuulizi w’enjiri omutambuze ayitibwa Mordecai Ham bwe yakuba enkuŋŋaana z’okuzuukusa mu Charlotte. Graham yagenda, nga ye yennyini bw’agamba yalina kwagala kumanya okusinga okukakasibwa, n’agenda mu maaso, n’asalawo okugoberera Kristo. Buli kiwandiiko ekyogera ku bulamu bwe, nga mw’otwalidde ekitabo kye yennyini eky’ebijjukizo, kitwala ekiro ekyo ng’ennyingo obulamu bwe kwe bwakyukira.

q: Graham yazuula atya nti yayitibwa okubuulira, era yasomera wa?
a: Kyatwala entandikwa etaagenda bulungi n’okuyigirizibwa okw’ekiseera ekiwanvu. Yeewandiisa mu Bob Jones College mu 1936 naye n’amalayo ekisanja kimu kyokka, oluvannyuma n’asengukira mu Florida Bible Institute okumpi ne Tampa, gye yakakasiza nti yayitibwa okubuulira, era n’awongebwa mu Southern Baptist mu 1939. Yeeyongerayo mu Wheaton College mu Illinois, gye yatikkirwa mu 1943 ne diguli mu by’obuwangwa bw’abantu (anthropology).

q: Ruth Bell yali ani, era baamala bbanga ki mu bufumbo?
a: Ruth McCue Bell yali muwala w’abaminsani b’ebyobujjanjabi mu China, Graham gwe yasisinkana bombi nga bayizi mu Wheaton College. Baafumbiriganwa mu 1943 e Montreat, North Carolina, ne babeera mu bufumbo emyaka nkaaga mu esatu, okutuusa Ruth lwe yafa mu 2007. Graham yawangaala emyaka emirala kkumi n’emu mu maka gaabwe ag’omu nsozi e Montreat.

q: Modesto Manifesto kye ki, era ddala kyamukuuma nga talina kavuyo?
a: Mu 1948, mu kasenge akatono e Modesto, California, Graham ne banne basatu be yali asinga okukwatagana nabo — Cliff Barrows, George Beverly Shea, ne Grady Wilson — baasalawo obukuumi buna obw’omulimu ogwali gubalindiridde: ensimbi ezikwatibwa mu bwesimbu era ezekebejjebwa, awatali kusabiriza nsimbi nga bali ku pulatifoomu; okwogera amazima amakakafu ku muwendo gw’abantu n’ogw’abakyuse; okukolera wamu n’abasumba ab’omu kitundu mu kifo ky’okuvuganya nabo; n’etteeka nti tewali n’omu ku bo yanditambudde, yandisisinkanye oba yandiriiridde emmere yekka n’omukazi atali mukazi we. Tekyali kiwandiiko ekyassibwako emikono, era erinnya erisikiriza lyajja oluvannyuma, naye obukuumi obwo bwanywera. Mu myaka amakumi mukaaga ng’ali waggulu ddala mu by’eddiini mu Amerika, yamaliriza nga talina kavuyo ka nsimbi wadde aka by’obukaba.

q: Lukuŋŋaana ki olunene olwafuula Billy Graham omumanyifu?
a: Omukisa omunene gwajja mu Los Angeles mu 1949, ttiimu ye gye yasimba weema ennene ey’ekika kya sekisi, "Canvas Cathedral," ne bateekateeka wiiki ssatu. Abantu ne beeyongera okujja, wiiki essatu ne zituuka ku munaana, era amawulire bwe gaamufaako omubuulizi ow’ekitundu yafuuka omuntu amanyiddwa mu ggwanga lyonna kumpi mu kiro kimu. Ebyaddirira byali tebibangawo: enkuŋŋaana ennene nga 400 mu nsi n’ebitundu ebisukka 185 mu myaka nga amakumi mukaaga.

Okusinziira ku kubala kwa Billy Graham Evangelistic Association, gye yatandikawo mu Minneapolis mu 1950, yabuulira mu maaso gaabwe abantu nga obukadde 215, era abasukka obukadde busatu baayanukula okuyita kwe okujja mu maaso — ng’atuuka, ng’okubala okwo bwe kulaga, ku bantu bangi mu maaso gaabwe okusinga oboolyawo omuntu yenna eyali abaddewo. Ekibiina ky’abantu ekisinga obunene kye yabuulira omulundi gumu, abasukka akakadde kamu, kyakuŋŋaanira mu Seoul mu 1973. Gino miwendo ekibiina kye kyennyini kye kyabalirira era kirungi okugitwala bwe kityo, naye ne bw’ogikendeezaako ginnyonnyola obunene bw’okutuuka ku bantu omubuulizi w’enjiri yenna eyamusooka bwe yali tasemberera. Yazimba n’ekyuma ekyakutambuza obubaka, nga mw’otwalidde pulogulaamu ya leediyo Hour of Decision okuva mu 1950 ne magazini Christianity Today, gye yayamba okutandikawo mu 1956.

q: Obubaka bwe bwali ki, era lwaki enkuŋŋaana ennene zaggalwanga n’oluyimba "Just As I Am"?
a: Okubuulira kwe kwali kwangu era nga kwesigamye ku Bayibuli — yamanyibwa olw’ebigambo bye yaddiŋŋananga, "Bayibuli egamba" — era tekwali nti abantu abalungi bagenda mu ggulu wabula nti aboonoonyi basonyiyibwa. Ku nkomerero, ekibiina bwe kyabanga kiyimba oluyimba olw’edda "Just As I Am," yayitanga abantu okuva mu ntebe zaabwe bajje mu maaso eri Kristo. Ekifaananyi ekyo eky’omugga gw’abantu ogutambula mpola nga gugenda gye pulatifoomu ng’oluyimba luddibwamu ky’ekifaananyi ensi kye yasigaza ku ye; oluvannyuma yeewola erinnya ly’oluyimba olwo n’aliteeka ku kitabo ky’obulamu bwe ekya 1997, Just As I Am.

q: Billy Graham yawakanya okwawula abantu okusinziira ku langi?
a: Yee. Mu 1953, mu lukuŋŋaana olunene e Chattanooga, Tennessee, yasanga ebifo eby’okutuulamu nga byawuddwamu emiguwa okwawula abaddugavu n’abeeru, era omukulu w’abaaniriza abagenyi bwe yagaana okuggyawo emiguwa egyo, Graham yaserengeta n’agisika n’agyekuulira yekka. Yagamba abaaniriza abagenyi nti emiguwa egyo gyandisigadde wansi, oba bandikubye olukuŋŋaana nga taliiwo, era okuva olwo n’afuula enkuŋŋaana ezitaawula bantu enkola ye ennywevu — okwesimbawo okwewuunyisa nga ebula emyaka egisukka kkumi Etteeka ly’Eddembe ly’Obuntu erya 1964 (Civil Rights Act) lituuke.

q: Graham yakwata atya enkolagana ye n’abapulezidenti n’akavuyo k’entambi za Nixon?
a: Yali musumba era mukwano gw’ekyama ogw’abapulezidenti okuva ku Truman okutuuka ku Obama, naye yali asinga okuba okumpi ne Richard Nixon, era okuba okumpi okwo kwamwonoona; oluvannyuma yawandiika nti okwesimbawo kwa Nixon "kwasirisa amaloboozi ag’omunda agaali gandabula okumala emyaka nneewale ebyobufuzi by’ebibiina." Ekisinga obubi, ekyakwatibwa mu Oval Office mu 1972 ne kifulumizibwa mu 2002 kyamukwata ng’ayogera ebigambo eby’okukyawa Abayudaaya, ng’akkiriziganya ne Nixon. Teyagezaako kukikendeeza: yeetonda mu lwatu era awatali kwekwasa, ng’agamba nti, "Sijjukira n’akamu nga nnina enneewulira ng’ezo ku kibinja kyonna, naddala Abayudaaya, era mazima kaakano sizirina," era bwe yali akaddiye n’ayongerako nti, "Bwe ntunuulira emabega, mmanyi nti oluusi nnasukka ensalo, era kaakano sandikikoze."

q: Billy Graham yamala atya emyaka gye egy’enkomerero, era yafa ddi?
a: Bwe yali mu myaka nsanvu, yazuulibwamu obulwadde bwa Parkinson, n’agenda akendeeza ku mulimu mu myaka egyaddirira, n’akwasa omulimu mutabani we Franklin, n’awummulira mu maka g’ab’omu nju ye e Montreat, North Carolina. Yafiirayo nga 21 Febwali 2018 ng’aweza emyaka kyenda mu mwenda. Omulambo gwe gwateekebwa mu kitiibwa mu Capitol Rotunda — omukulembeze w’eddiini eyasooka okuweebwa ekitiibwa ekyo — n’oluvannyuma n’aziikibwa okumpi ne Ruth e Charlotte mu ssanduuko ya mbaawo ennyangu eyakolebwa abasibe b’omu kkomera, wansi w’ejjinja ly’entaana eriwandiikiddwako ebigambo ebyangu bino byokka: "Omubuulizi w’Enjiri ya Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo."
